meta.name: Anchor MVP
meta.oneLiner: A local-first Android personal operating system for attention, food, fitness, pantry, productivity, learning and finance - with deterministic state and selective AI reasoning.
meta.note: This tracker turns the architecture blueprint into an executable Anchor build plan. Target device: Pixel 9. Platform: native Android with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.
meta.coreRule: The LLM may reason, rank, explain and extract. It never owns truth, money, timers, balances, macro arithmetic, pantry quantities or app-block state.

milestones.name: Foundation
milestones.goal: A native Compose shell persists versioned local state through Room/DataStore and exposes testable repository boundaries.
milestones.exit: App reloads state, migrations run, and event_log records meaningful changes.

milestones.name: Guardian core
milestones.goal: Device Owner enforcement suspends distracting packages, records usage and re-blocks after a fixed exception.
milestones.exit: Reddit/YouTube can be suspended and safely restored without stranding the phone.

milestones.name: AI decision layer
milestones.goal: Typed, bounded AI reasoning sits behind deterministic policy and a resilient FastAPI gateway.
milestones.exit: An unlock reason produces a validated decision or a conservative local fallback.

milestones.name: Health and imports
milestones.goal: Provider history becomes canonical orders, meals, macro totals and explainable preference signals.
milestones.exit: An anonymized import produces normalized items and reproducible nutrition calculations.

milestones.name: Pantry
milestones.goal: Inventory changes, depletion forecasts and low-confidence checks are locally reproducible.
milestones.exit: Manual correction, meal consumption and delivered groceries update stock correctly.

milestones.name: Commerce
milestones.goal: Swiggy Food and Instamart MCP capabilities can build candidate carts behind an explicit confirmation boundary.
milestones.exit: The user reviews the final cart and confirms payment before any order tool executes.

milestones.name: Productivity
milestones.goal: Goals, learning units, sessions, commitments and productive debt become structured state.
milestones.exit: An overdue commitment deterministically affects an entertainment exception.

milestones.name: Finance
milestones.goal: Read-only Reconcile data, balances and candidate updates feed deterministic budgets and net worth.
milestones.exit: Spend and net worth update without model-owned arithmetic or unreviewed writes.

milestones.name: Today orchestration
milestones.goal: One daily surface combines Focus, Health, Pantry, Finance and Productivity state.
milestones.exit: A morning check-in produces a compact, explainable cross-feature view.

milestones.name: Hardening
milestones.goal: Background jobs, recovery, auditability and failure handling make the app safe for daily use.
milestones.exit: Network/model/provider failures cannot corrupt state or lock critical phone functions.

architectureNotes:
## Personal OS MVP architecture

### Core rule

The phone owns policy, truth and long-term memory. The LLM may reason, rank, explain and extract, but it never owns money, timers, balances, macro arithmetic, pantry quantities or app-block state.

### System shape

```
Pixel 9 Android app
  Compose UI -> ViewModel -> UseCase / Engine -> Repository -> Room / Android API / MCP

  Room + SQLite + FTS
    profile facts | current state | bounded recent events | raw history | event log

  Deterministic engines
    Guardian | Macro | Pantry | Productivity | Finance | CommerceCoordinator

  AI orchestration
    Tier 0 deterministic -> Tier 1 Gemini Nano -> Tier 2 DeepSeek V4 Flash -> Tier 3 Groq GPT-OSS 120B

  External capabilities
    FastAPI /v1/reason | Swiggy Food MCP | Instamart MCP | Reconcile read-only ContentProvider
```

### Android package boundaries

```
com.personalos
  app/                 # Application, MainActivity, navigation
  core/database/       # Room, DAOs, migrations
  core/model/          # Shared domain models
  core/ai/             # ContextBuilder, ModelRouter, schemas
  core/policy/         # Deterministic rules and calculators
  core/network/        # Gateway and MCP clients
  core/security/       # Keystore and auth helpers
  core/notifications/  # Channels and notification builders
  feature/today/       # Cross-feature daily view
  feature/guardian/    # Blocking and exceptions
  feature/health/      # Meals, macros and preferences
  feature/pantry/      # Inventory and depletion
  feature/productivity/# Goals, learning and commitments
  feature/finance/     # Budgets, assets and net worth
  feature/settings/    # Targets and notification windows
  integration/reconcile/
  integration/swiggy/
  integration/imports/
```

### Local memory hierarchy

- Hard profile: restrictions, goals, app categories and hard budget rules.
- Derived profile: preference confidence, typical spend and unlock reliability.
- Current state: today's macros, current block mode, pantry warnings and cash available.
- Recent events: a small bounded window such as the last three unlocks or meals.
- Raw history: all orders, transactions, usage sessions and pantry events; never dump wholesale to a model.
- Free text: notes and commitment reasons retrieved through SQLite FTS. No vector database in MVP.

### AI request contract

1. Classify feature, intent and risk.
2. Fetch relevant current state and global hard constraints.
3. Fetch at most 10 ranked memory facts and 5 recent events.
4. Add the request and expected JSON schema.
5. Validate schema and policy before accepting the result.

`AIRequestContext` carries `feature`, `currentState`, `hardRules`, `relevantMemory`, `recentEvents`, `request` and the expected typed schema.

### Guardian contract

Device Owner plus `DevicePolicyManager.setPackagesSuspended()` enforces blocks; `UsageStatsManager` measures outcomes. A request captures reason and duration, then deterministic cooldown/sleep/commitment/max-exception checks run before any model call. A validated `UnlockDecisionV1` may unsuspend a package and schedule expiry. The app then re-suspends it, records the commitment outcome and updates a Beta-style reliability score. Emergency communication, navigation, authenticator, password-manager, maps and payment-critical packages stay allowlisted.

### Health, pantry and commerce

Canonical order imports normalize Swiggy, Zomato, Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart and other exports. Macro arithmetic, preference evidence, inventory deltas and depletion forecasts are local calculations. A predicted grocery list becomes live Instamart candidates only after the local state is ready. Commerce uses official Kotlin MCP clients with OAuth 2.1 PKCE and Keystore tokens. The user reviews candidates, cart, total, address and macro/budget impact before payment/order execution.

### Finance boundary

Reconcile remains responsible for SMS parsing and transaction normalization. Personal OS reads incremental data through a signature-protected, read-only ContentProvider. Finance updates from text/screenshots become candidates, show a diff, pass validation and only then write local snapshots. Net worth, spend, budgets and food-budget pressure are deterministic.

### MVP schema

`profile_fact`, `event_log`, `blocked_app_rule`, `unlock_request`, `unlock_decision`, `commitment`, `usage_session`, `reliability_score`, `order`, `order_item`, `food_preference`, `meal`, `daily_nutrition`, `pantry_item`, `pantry_event`, `goal`, `learning_unit`, `learning_session`, `transaction_cache`, `asset_account`, `asset_snapshot`, `networth_snapshot` and `budget`. Every JSON payload has a schema version and every meaningful current value has an event or snapshot behind it.

### Jobs and safety

Guardian expiry, usage aggregation, pantry forecast, low-stock notifications, Reconcile sync and daily finance aggregation are deterministic WorkManager/system jobs. Gemini Nano runs only while the app is foreground. If the gateway or network fails, local state and calculations continue; if model JSON is invalid, the action fails closed; if an order placement is ambiguous, status/history is checked before retry; if a migration fails, backup happens before destructive work.

### Explicit MVP non-goals

No perfect lie detector, invasive content surveillance, automatic financial transactions, autonomous purchases, cloud-first sync, embeddings/vector memory, extra live commerce providers or voice-first ambient agent. Browser/VPN enforcement, automatic replenishment, predictive cashflow and fine-grained tutorial verification move to V2.

### Reference stack

Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material 3, MVVM, use cases, repositories, Hilt, Room, DataStore, kotlinx.serialization, Ktor or OkHttp, WorkManager, Android Keystore, DevicePolicyManager, UsageStatsManager, ML Kit GenAI/Barcode/Document Scanner, FastAPI/Pydantic, DeepSeek V4 Flash, Groq GPT-OSS 120B and official MCP Kotlin SDK.

decisionLog.decision: Start a native Android app rather than extending the old web project
decisionLog.why: The target is Pixel 9 and the core capabilities require Android Device Owner, UsageStatsManager, Room, WorkManager, Keystore and ContentProvider APIs.

decisionLog.decision: Keep one Gradle app module with strict package boundaries
decisionLog.why: It keeps the MVP fast to build while preserving seams for later module extraction when build time or ownership justifies it.
Blocking, finance, health, pantry and commitments must continue safely without network access or a model provider.

decisionLog.decision: Deterministic engines own all high-consequence state transitions
decisionLog.why: Models can produce useful reasoning but must not directly write balances, timers, quantities, arithmetic or DevicePolicyManager actions.

decisionLog.decision: Use tiered AI routing with bounded context
decisionLog.why: Deterministic logic handles predictable work, Gemini Nano handles foreground extraction, DeepSeek handles harder reasoning and Groq provides fallback.

decisionLog.decision: Use structured retrieval and SQLite FTS before embeddings
decisionLog.why: The MVP needs explainable profile facts, current state and bounded event windows; a vector database adds complexity before a real retrieval failure exists.

decisionLog.decision: Require explicit final confirmation for food and grocery orders
decisionLog.why: The assistant may find candidates and build a cart, but it must never autonomously spend money or retry a non-idempotent order blindly.
Reconcile remains the transaction-normalization authority; Anchor consumes incremental summaries through protected Android IPC.

decisionLog.decision: Use light event sourcing for important values
decisionLog.why: Current state plus the event or snapshot that changed it makes pantry, finance, usage and commitment behavior explainable and recoverable.

decisionLog.decision: Build in the order Foundation -> Guardian -> AI -> Health -> Pantry -> Commerce -> Productivity -> Finance -> Today -> Hardening
decisionLog.why: The smart surface should sit on stable state machines, imports and arithmetic rather than becoming the source of truth.
